neighbours.label: sentence boundaries and discourse turns in biomedical research prose (the period or comma before a new claim, 'However', 'There are')
fire: Long-term efficacy has not been established. For a distinct group of patients, however, the drug may help.
The trial showed a modest benefit. However, side effects were common in older adults.
Adults disabled by the disease have been largely neglected. There are, however, promising therapies.
The mechanism remains unclear. Therefore, further studies of the receptor are needed.
Genetic risk factors were identified in the cohort. This funding will support follow-up work.
Earlier studies were small. Nevertheless, the association with diabetes has been reported repeatedly.
The vaccine reduced infection rates. However, its effect on transmission is still debated.
Biomarkers for early diagnosis are lacking. Thus, new screening approaches are urgently needed.
quiet: The bakery opened early on Monday and the bread sold out fast.
The trail was muddy after the rain and the hikers walked slowly.
Adults who visit the park often bring their dogs and a picnic.
The kitchen was painted yellow and the curtains were blue.
My cousin plays guitar in a small band on weekends.
The old bridge was repaired last summer with new stone.
The festival brought music and food to the whole town.
Our neighbours planted roses along the front fence.

notes: Card: '.' x5, ',' x3, ' However' x3, indentation in code x7; top examples are medical-research prose. + pole: METHODS, 'A 9-page questionnaire', 'For the study,'.
